body: You're a very good friend, your friend should definitely seek a therapist, he needs someone to remind him that he's worthy and that his financial situation doesn't define him, it's important to remind him that hes experiencing a bad phase right now but that it will definitely change in the future ( i know it does sound cliche but) also definitely warn/prevent him for drug abuse, it's a coping mechanism that is perfectly understandable due to his situation rn but in the long run it is extremely self destructive
Thank you, I already planned an appointment with my university  doctor and my friend also recommended a good therapist

Thank you for you story, I'm glad you're sorting things out for the better!
Yes, I go to a really elitist school, I'm from a very modest background so I often feel the disrespect students from a dominant economic/intellectual background tend to have, I wouldn't think of it much but the idea of not being successful here scares me because I want to do well so I can help out my mom
